items.tag: Viesigners · Launch of our first online coaching offer
paras: To support the launch of our new coaching offer, we needed to generate qualified opportunities without resorting to cold outreach. Rather than forcing sales, we put in place a targeted content and lead magnet strategy, combined with strict qualification processes and personalized conversations.
The main goal was to build a captive audience and structure an organic acquisition ecosystem capable of driving our revenue in a predictable way.
items.role: Content strategy, lead magnet creation, qualification processes, community building, social selling and marketing.

paras: Dialog Insight, a digital marketing SaaS platform, was rolling out a brand-new information architecture. The challenge was to ensure a smooth transition for a base of expert, set-in-their-ways and demanding users. Working with members of the marketing team, I conducted dozens of customer interviews to refine the messaging, helped establish the communication rules and wrote strategic in-product communications (banners, modals, display rules, etc.).
The main goal was to coordinate cross-team efforts to make the value of the new features easy to grasp and ensure fast adoption, while easing the load on the support team.
items.role: SaaS product marketing, user research, copywriting, information architecture, B2B content strategy.

items.alt: Landing page for a valuables-buying service
items.p: For this valuables-buying service, instant authority and trust had to be established. By rethinking the marketing message to tackle objections head-on and optimizing the page design, we multiplied inquiries without changing their offer or their ad budget.

items.alt: Landing page for a niche-market offer
items.p: The challenge was to propel acquisition in a very niche market. By completely overhauling the core offer and rethinking the messaging angles for Meta Ads, we turned a minimal budget into a true growth machine.

quote.text: A huge thank you to Charles-Erick for his remarkable work!

roles: Meta Ads strategy guidance and alignment

items.alt: Landing page for a metal roofing company
items.p: This project required positioning a premium offer and quickly educating prospects to justify the investment in a metal roof (“40 years of peace of mind”). The new web architecture effectively filters and qualifies the clientele:

quote.text: I recommend him to any business that wants to turn its campaigns into real results!

items.alt: Landing page for a local service business
items.p: The goal was to get the most out of local ad campaigns. By eliminating all friction in getting in touch and strategically integrating social proof, the page now instantly converts search queries into estimate requests.

quote.text: Charles-Erick, I want to launch a new service and I'd like us to repeat the same success. When are you available this week?

sections.h2: What it feels like *to work with me*

items.name: Marie-Eve Gratton
items.title: A true reference when it comes to web strategy and UX design
items.text: What can I say about Charles-Érick… a truly one-of-a-kind human. His great strength is his ability to take his clients and colleagues to another level through his strategic thinking and his fine understanding of UX. Charles-Érick is a reference when it comes to web strategy and UX design. His approach is always thoughtful, clear and structured. It’s also a real pleasure to collaborate with him and to bring visually to life the ideas we develop together. I recommend him without hesitation!

items.name: Emilie Gosselin
items.title: A key person on different mandates!
items.text: Always bringing innovative and creative solutions while demonstrating real added value. Always looking for the best solution to meet users' needs, his thinking was in-depth, methodical and based on thorough research. It was a real pleasure to work and think with Charles-Erick on various strategic projects, for clients or to help the Agency evolve.

items.name: Tony Raymond
items.title: Charles-Erick is a genuine idea machine!
items.text: Inventive, structured and open-minded, he doesn't hesitate to question ideas, both his own and those of others, if it can improve results. His know-how is matched only by his people skills, and he has the qualities of a leader within a team. It was a pleasure to collaborate with him.

faq.q: What kinds of mandates does Charles-Erick BG take on?
a: Consulting and delivery mandates in digital marketing and growth, product design and UX/UI design, mainly for service businesses, SaaS platforms and mobile apps.

faq.q: Where is he based and which languages does he work in?
a: Quebec, Canada. He works in French and English, in English- and French-speaking markets.
